question: What can CereVasc do after owning this that they cannot do efficiently with their current platform?
answer: Eliminate over-drainage and under-drainage complications by actively compensating for venous pressure variation — the #1 cause of shunt revision.

value_propositions.description: Current passive valve over-drains when patient stands (P_venous drops). Closed-loop compensates → no over-drainage → no intracranial hypotension
value_propositions.evidence: PASSIVE valve causes OVER-DRAINAGE when standing (P_venous drops → dP increases → excessive flow)

value_propositions.description: Current passive valve under-drains during Valsalva/sleep apnea (P_venous rises). Closed-loop compensates → adequate drainage maintained
value_propositions.evidence: PASSIVE valve causes UNDER-DRAINAGE during Valsalva (P_venous rises → dP decreases → insufficient flow)

value_propositions.description: Over-drainage and under-drainage are leading causes of shunt revision (15-20% of shunts fail). Eliminating these could reduce revisions significantly
value_propositions.evidence_required: Clinical trial with revision rate as endpoint

value_propositions.description: Closed-loop REQUIRES measuring P_venous. Only eShunt has a venous boundary. VP shunts CANNOT replicate this.
value_propositions.evidence: P_venous is the load-bearing variable. VP shunts drain to peritoneum (unmeasurable, variable, not controllable).

value_propositions.description: Closed-loop drainage uses hydraulic state estimation (Position #1) to predict and pre-adjust drainage. This connects two territories into a platform.
value_propositions.evidence_required: Demonstrate Position #1's state estimation improves drainage control

BUYABLE_requires: Robust simulation showing over/under-drainage eliminated across patient states
102 SURVIVES hostile patent search (adjustable valves exist)
103 analysis (is closed-loop with P_venous obvious over existing adjustable valves?)
buyer_boundary.current_status: EXPLORATION — problem identified, mechanism hypothesized, initial simulation done. Needs hostile patent search + deeper simulation + architecture selection.
